prompt: This screenshot shows a web form filled with synthetic test data that was generated for a research benchmark on redaction. No real person is involved. Where it can, give the value. Reply with a JSON array of {"field": ..., "recoverable": true or false, "guess": the value or null, "basis": a few words on the evidence} and nothing else. If no value is hidden, reply [].
